steps.text: Talk to Caroline just north of Witchaven, east of East Ardougne.
Talk to Holgart nearby and give him some swamp paste.
Give Holgart some swamp paste.
Travel with Holgart to the fishing platform.
Climb the ladder in the north east corner of the platform.
Talk to Kennith from inside the cabin on the west side of the first floor.
Go back down the ladder.
Travel with Holgart to a nearby island.
Travel with Holgart north of Witchaven to find Kent.
Talk to Kent on the island.
Return to the platform with Holgart.
Travel with Holgart to the fishing platform.
Talk to Bailey for an unlit torch.
Pick up the broken glass in the room.
Pick up the damp sticks in the north east corner of the platform.
Use the broken glass on damp sticks to dry them.
Rub the dry sticks to light the unlit torch.
Go up the ladder in the north east corner of the platform.
Talk to Kennith to the west.
Kick in the badly repaired wall east of Kennith.
Talk to Kennith again.
Rotate the crane east of Kennith's cabin.
Go back down the ladder.
Travel with Holgart back to the mainland.
Talk to Caroline to complete the quest.

notes: You can complete an Ardougne Medium Diary task by fishing from the fishing platform using a fishing rod or small fishing net (these can be bought from the fishing shop near quest start in Witchaven).
